name: Circuit: Left Bank Blocks
about: Short, tight laps round the blocks behind the left bank. Hard braking, quick corners, no room for mistakes.

name: Circuit: Montmartre
about: Narrow streets below the hill of Montmartre in the autumn rain. Slippery, twisty and unforgiving.

name: Circuit: Seine Loop
about: Along both banks of the Seine and over two bridges, into the summer sunset.

name: Circuit: Le Marais
about: A short, punchy loop through the old streets of the Marais. Every corner counts.

name: Circuit: Champs-Elysees
about: Flat out down the widest avenue in Paris at night, then back along the river.

name: Circuit: Bastille
about: Wide boulevards round the east of the city on a wet autumn morning.

name: Circuit: Left Bank Diagonals
about: Two long diagonal avenues across the left bank on a warm summer night. High speeds, sharp ends.

name: Circuit: Grands Boulevards
about: The great boulevards across the north of Paris in the evening rain. Long, fast and wide.

name: Circuit: Grand Tour
about: Boulevards, the Bastille, the south bank and the Champs-Elysees: one big tour of Paris.

name: Circuit: Midnight Snow Tour
about: The final challenge: all the way round Paris on the Peripherique, at midnight in the snow.

name: Circuit: Downtown Blocks
about: Fast laps around a tight downtown block. Short straights and hard corners: brake late, stay clean.

name: Circuit: Georgetown
about: The old streets of Georgetown in the autumn rain. Narrow, twisty and slippery all the way round.

name: Circuit: The Ellipse
about: Long sweeping bends past the monuments into the summer sunset. Smooth lines win this one.

name: Circuit: Chinatown
about: A short, punchy loop through Chinatown. Every corner counts: one mistake and the pack is gone.

name: Circuit: Lakeside
about: Fast stretches along the water, then a twisty run back through the city, on a rainy spring evening.

name: Circuit: Avenue Sprint
about: Built around the broad avenues: flat out on the long straights, then stand on the brakes.

name: Circuit: Southeast Sweep
about: Long laps through the southeast of the city on a warm summer night. High speeds, wide turns.

name: Circuit: West End
about: The shortest circuit in Washington, in the evening rain. Close racing from start to finish.

name: Circuit: Grand Tour
about: Across the city centre, down the long avenue, then flat out on the southern freeway and up the west parkway. A big tour with no second chances.

name: Circuit: Midnight Snow Tour
about: The final challenge: all the way round Washington on its highways and outer avenues, at midnight in the snow.
